activeRoute: E4 / USABILITY_TEST_MONEY_PATHS / isolated exchange-review browser validation
scope: Existing Mini App buy and sell review opening, keyboard containment, recipient rendering, acknowledgement, expiry and blocked synthetic submission at 320, 390 and 1280 pixel viewport widths.
canonicalContext: docs/CURRENT_ROUTE.md current E4 route and relevant completed UX slices

independentChecks.cases: Seven acknowledgement boundaries, four buy snapshot/tag modes, two normalized sell snapshots; overlap with the 44 pytest cases, not additional unique coverage.

independentChecks.kind: product diff and browser evidence inspection
independentChecks.browserExecutedBy: root implementer; reviewer inspected code, hashes, report and isolation evidence
visualInspection: 320-buy.png: initial title, route, custody and fees visible; long recipient wraps
320-sell-card.png: initial title, route, custody, payout and synthetic card recipient visible

findings.observation: Baseline acknowledgement focus scrolled the 320-pixel review to scrollTop 437 and hid its heading.
findings.resolution: Review resets its scroll surface and focuses the accessible heading with preventScroll. All 15 final opening observations report scrollTop 0, visible heading and no horizontal overflow.

findings.observation: Moving initial focus to a non-tabbable heading requires handling Tab and Shift+Tab from that heading, in addition to wrapping first/last controls.
findings.resolution: The updated handler explicitly contains focus from a noninteractive initial target; real browser checks also cover disabled/enabled confirmation, Escape and cancel focus restoration.

findings.observation: The first expanded browser run used case-sensitive innerText assertions despite CSS uppercase label rendering.
findings.resolution: The final runner checks source textContent for literal content and separately verifies visibility/geometry in the browser. The final report passes against the exact reviewed product and runner hashes.

findings.observation: Reviewer attempts with /root/venv/bin/python and python3 could not import pytest.
findings.resolution: The installed /opt/lumi/venv/bin/python environment ran all 44 focused cases successfully; no installation or dependency change was needed.

limits: This review accepts the bounded exchange browser slice, not full E4 gate completion or human comprehension.
No real Telegram-device, screen-reader or native-wallet-signing acceptance is claimed.
All browser data and intercepted submissions are synthetic; no real API, customer dataset, credential, wallet signature or money movement was used.
Production rollout was not yet performed at review time and must be verified separately.
Earlier canonical blockers and frozen 064A authority remain unchanged.

nextCanonicalItem.route: E4 / explicit action review / wallet action-specific wording and network-fee disclosure
nextCanonicalItem.evidence: walletTransfer and walletPay reuse a modal whose description says an order has not been created and whose confirmation says create, although they hand off a signature or pay an existing order. Their review rows omit network-fee disclosure required by the E4 gate.
nextCanonicalItem.boundedAcceptance: Use action-specific description and confirmation wording, disclose fees without inventing an estimate, and validate the existing signature handoff using keyless synthetic fixtures and blocked signing/writers.
nextCanonicalItem.reasonNotRepeatedVertical: This addresses observed semantics and fee gaps in existing wallet actions; it does not repeat the accepted exchange-recipient/browser or visible-portfolio slices.
